upgrade_rules.description: Helm values.yaml changed; review the values.yaml diff section and update your deployment values accordingly.
Database migrations changed. Migrations run automatically on upgrade; take a database backup before deploying this version.
Deployment documentation or tooling changed; review the updated instructions if you self-host.

sections.description: 3-6 highlight bullets of user-visible changes. A subset of What changed, not a superset. For features, state the user or operator benefit; for fixes, state the resolved symptom.
New product capabilities. Each item must explicitly state the user benefit.
Bug fixes that restore or correct existing behavior.
UI and frontend changes (pages, components, forms, navigation).
API, services, background jobs, and backend performance or reliability changes.
Helm, Docker, CI, and other deployment changes (not the dependency version table).
Operator actions required on upgrade. Git rules already cover Helm values, migrations, and docs; only add other breaking or config items.
